purpose: Open synthetic calibration packets for reviewer training and codebook refinement.
disclosure: The corpus and its separate oracle are public. This is not a blinded holdout and must not be used as a confirmatory or hidden test set.

records.claim: Every tool call made by the agent passes through the named wrapper PEP before the wrapper invokes the tool.
records.declared_scope: One agent process, one named wrapper, the six documented tool methods in the supplied harness, one test build.
supplied_evidence: Source review identifies the wrapper as the only call path exposed by the harness.
Instrumented tests show all six documented wrapper methods invoke PEP-7 before dispatch.
Negative controls show wrapper requests are denied when PEP-7 denies.
declared_assumptions: The claim is limited to the six documented methods and the named harness build.
records.reviewer_instruction: Appraise only this claim within its stated scope. Do not infer missing facts. Distinguish unsupported evidence from contradictory observations, and distinguish not-claimed from unproven.

records.claim: Every operation capable of changing the protected resource, regardless of route, is mediated by PEP-7.
records.declared_scope: The deployed service and all routes capable of changing protected records.
supplied_evidence: Instrumented tests show the six documented wrapper methods invoke PEP-7.
An alternate import endpoint and direct database credential path are reachable, but neither is included in the route inventory.
No protected-resource tests cover the alternate import endpoint or direct database path.
declared_assumptions: The route inventory is incomplete.
records.reviewer_instruction: Appraise only this claim within its stated scope. Do not infer missing facts. Distinguish unsupported evidence from contradictory observations, and distinguish not-claimed from unproven.

records.reviewer_instruction: Appraise only this claim within its stated scope. Do not infer missing facts. Distinguish unsupported evidence from contradictory observations, and distinguish not-claimed from unproven.

records.reviewer_instruction: Appraise only this claim within its stated scope. Do not infer missing facts. Distinguish unsupported evidence from contradictory observations, and distinguish not-claimed from unproven.

records.claim: A revoked session cannot perform the named protected write after revocation becomes effective and is known to the enforcement plane.
records.declared_scope: All active sessions enumerated in the frozen deployment snapshot, over the stated test interval.
supplied_evidence: Authority-native revocation event carries effective time and monotonic epoch 42.
Every enumerated session reports observed epoch 42 before the post-revocation write tests.
All post-revocation writes are denied at the resource-side enforcement point; read-only reconciliation remains available.
declared_assumptions: The session inventory is declared complete for this bounded test deployment.
records.reviewer_instruction: Appraise only this claim within its stated scope. Do not infer missing facts. Distinguish unsupported evidence from contradictory observations, and distinguish not-claimed from unproven.

records.claim: All sessions and delegated descendants enforce revocation before any later protected write.

One disconnected worker and its delegated child are absent from the session inventory; no propagation or effect evidence is supplied for them.
